hard_rejection_allowed_only_when: parent and proposed product or neutral-loss formulas parse without ambiguity
adduct, charge, radical, and isotope assumptions are explicit
the proposed elemental balance is impossible under those frozen assumptions
ambiguous_action: retain for audit and do not count formula compatibility as positive or negative evidence
compatible_action: mark chemical plausibility only; do not add a fixed score and do not change the empirical likelihood ratio
seed_requirements: primary paper, textbook, or official technical source
joint_rules: two fragments may enter only as one jointly estimated event after the single-fragment rule family is frozen
